ported: OCR_PROVIDERS["vertex-deepseek-ocr"]: no built-in model, Bearer auth, the caller's deployed model id sent as supplied
VERTEX_DEEPSEEK_TRANSFORMATION.buildRequest: POST JSON { model, messages: [{ role: "user", content: [{ type: "image_url", image_url: <document url> }] }] } with Authorization: Bearer <token>

VERTEX_DEEPSEEK_TRANSFORMATION.parseResponse: choices[0].message.content as a JSON { pages, model?, usage_info? } string or one markdown page at index 0; usage as the fallback usage_info; the answer's model when present
VERTEX_DEEPSEEK_RETIRED_MODEL_ID (deepseek-ocr-maas) and handleOcr's 400 refusal of it

resolveVertexOcrBaseUrl: https://aiplatform.googleapis.com/v1/projects/{project}/locations/{region}/endpoints/openapi/chat/completions, region us-central1 by default, providerSpecificData.project before the Service Account project_id
resolveVertexOcrAccessToken and handleOcr's token choice: an existing accessToken wins, a Service Account JSON mints a token, a raw apiKey is used as an access token
notPorted: connection base URLs (credentials.baseUrl, providerSpecificData.baseUrl) for dedicated Model Garden endpoints: the target is only the project/region endpoint on https://aiplatform.googleapis.com, and a configured base URL is refused
gs:// document URLs: the foundation accepts public https URLs and bounded data URLs only
inline PDF data URLs: the document travels as an image_url part, so inline documents must be images
the mistral and azure-document-intelligence registry entries: separate units
the /v1/ocr route, account selection, rate-limit checks and OmniRoute meta headers: registration and integration work

supportedSubset.auth: Authorization: Bearer <token> from the connection accessToken, a minted Service Account or authorized_user ADC token, or a raw apiKey used as an access token
supportedSubset.project: providerSpecificData.project or .projectId (must agree), else Service Account project_id, else ADC quota_project_id; Google Cloud project id syntax
supportedSubset.region: providerSpecificData.region or .location (must agree), default us-central1; regional location id syntax
supportedSubset.models: any caller-named deployed model id (optionally prefixed vertex-deepseek-ocr/), never deepseek-ocr-maas in any publisher qualification
supportedSubset.documents: document_url or image_url: a public https URL, or a base64 image data URL (png, jpeg, webp, gif, tiff)
supportedSubset.polling: none: the endpoint answers synchronously; a status header on the answer is ignored

intentionalContractChanges: a configured base URL is refused instead of overriding the endpoint, so the key is only sent to the Vertex origin
project and region must be plain Google Cloud ids (they are built into the URL path) and conflicting source/fork spellings are refused
a JSON credential that is neither a Service Account nor an authorized_user file is refused, never sent as a raw token; ADC files mint tokens as in this fork's other Vertex paths
the retired id is refused in any form (bare, provider-prefixed, publisher-qualified), case-insensitively
the request is validated and the connection resolved before any token is minted; minting is bounded (15 s) and abortable
an answer without choices or without string content is a lost result (502 with acceptedJob) instead of an empty page
when the answer names no model the requested deployed id is reported instead of the provider id

exports.parseVertexDeepseekOcrResponse: (raw, { model }) -> { model, pages, usage_info? }; throws on a malformed answer
exports.createVertexDeepseekOcrAdapter: ({ project, region, token }) -> frozen foundation adapter for one connection
exports.vertexDeepseekOcrScope: (credentials) -> { project, region, credential }; throws { status, vertexOcrAuth }
exports.resolveVertexOcrToken: (scope, { mintToken?, log?, proxyOptions?, signal?, timeoutMs }) -> Bearer token
exports.defaultVertexOcrTokenMinter: ({ sa, adc }, { log, proxyOptions }) -> access token via services/tokenRefresh.js
exports.runVertexDeepseekOcr: ({ body, credentials, signal?, fetchImpl?, sleepImpl?, mintToken?, timeoutMs?, tokenTimeoutMs?, maxResponseBytes?, log? }) -> foundation result

failures.local: retired model, invalid request, configuration or credential refusal, mint failure, abort before the send: nothing billable was sent, local: true
failures.provider: the foundation's ocrRefusal mapping (401, 402 quotaExhausted, 403, 429 with Retry-After, 5xx as submit-unknown acceptedJob)
failures.acceptedJob: any failure after the document was sent; the caller must not replay it on this or another connection

integrationPoints.change: route provider vertex-deepseek-ocr to runVertexDeepseekOcr with the selected connection; stop account fallback when the result has acceptedJob or local
declare vertex-deepseek-ocr as an OCR provider (Bearer / Service Account credential, providerSpecificData project and region) and document it with /v1/ocr
